name: CreateFunction

parameters.help_en: The name of the service
parameters.help_zh: 服务的名称
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

fields.help_en: The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket that stores the ZIP package of the function code
fields.help_zh: 存放函数代码ZIP包的OSS Bucket名称
fields.name: oss_bucket_name

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS object (ZIP package) that contains the function code
fields.help_zh: 存放函数代码ZIP包的OSS Object名称
fields.name: oss_object_name

fields.help_en: The ZIP package of the function code that is encoded in Base64 format
fields.help_zh: 函数代码ZIP包的Base 64编码
fields.name: zip_file

parameters.help_en: The ZIP package of function code. Configure either code or customContainerConfig
parameters.help_zh: 函数代码ZIP包。code和customContainerConfig二选一
parameters.name: code

fields.help_en: The startup argument of the container
fields.help_zh: 容器启动参数
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The startup command of the container
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The endpoint of the container image
fields.help_zh: 容器镜像地址
fields.name: image

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable image acceleration. Valid values:

Default: enables image acceleration.
None: disables image acceleration
fields.help_zh:
是否开启镜像加速。
Default：默认值，表示开启镜像加速。
None：表示关闭镜像加速
fields.name: acceleration_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the image repository for the Container Registry Enterprise Edition. You must specify this parameter if you use an image of Container Registry Enterprise Edition
fields.help_zh: ACR企业版镜像仓库ID，使用ACR企业版镜像时须传入
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the web server mode. Valid values:

true (default): enables web server mode. In this case, web servers must be implemented in container images to listen for and process requests.
false: disables web server mode. In this case, the container exits the process after running and the exit code must be 0
fields.help_zh:
镜像运行是否为Web Server模式。
取值为true表示需要在容器镜像中实现Web Server来监听端口并处理请求。
取值为false表示需要容器运行后主动退出进程，并且ExitCode需要为0。

默认值为true
fields.name: web_server_mode

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the Custom Container runtime. After you configure the Custom Container runtime, Function Compute can execute the function in a container that is created from a custom image. Configure either code or customContainerConfig
parameters.help_zh: Custom Container运行时的相关配置，成功配置后函数可以使用自定义容器镜像执行函数。code和customContainerConfig二选一
parameters.name: custom_container_config

parameters.help_en:
The layers.

Multiple layers are merged in the order determined by their array subscripts, from largest to smallest. When there are files with the same name, the content from the layer with the smaller subscript will overwrite the corresponding file in the layer with the larger subscript
parameters.help_zh:
层的列表。
多个层会按照数组下标从大到小的顺序进行合并，下标小的层的内容会覆盖下标大的层的同名文件
parameters.name: layers

parameters.help_en: The description of the function
parameters.help_zh: 函数的描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the function. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot begin with a digit or a hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh: 函数的名称。只能包含字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以数字、短划线（-）开头，长度范围为1~64个字符
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.help_en: The handler of the function. The format varies based on the programming language you use. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数执行的入口，具体格式和语言相关。详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.name: handler

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the Initializer hook. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3. Valid values: 1 to 300. The execution of the Initializer hook is terminated once the timeout period expires
parameters.help_zh: 初始化函数运行的超时时间，默认值为3秒，单位为秒。最小1秒，最大为5分钟。当初始化函数超过这个时间后，函数会被终止执行
parameters.name: initialization_timeout

parameters.help_en: The Initializer hook. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.help_zh: 初始化函数执行的入口。详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
parameters.name: initializer

parameters.help_en: The memory capacity for the function. Unit: MB. The memory capacity must be a multiple of 64 MB. The capacity varies based on the type of the function instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179379.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数的内存规格，单位为MB，内存大小为64 MB的倍数。不同的函数实例类型，内存规格存在差异。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179379.html
parameters.name: memory_size

parameters.help_en: The runtime of the function. Valid values: nodejs20, nodejs18, nodejs16, nodejs14, nodejs12, nodejs10, nodejs8, nodejs6, nodejs4.4, python3.10, python3.9, python3, python2.7, java11, java8, go1, php7.2, dotnetcore3.1, dotnetcore2.1, custom.debian10, custom, and custom-container.******** For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73338.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数运行的语言环境。目前支持nodejs20、nodejs18、nodejs20、nodejs18、nodejs16、nodejs14、nodejs12、nodejs10、nodejs8、nodejs6、nodejs4.4、python3.10、python3.9、python3、python2.7、java11、java8、go1、php7.2、dotnetcore3.1、dotnetcore2.1、custom.debian10、custom和custom-container。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73338.html
parameters.name: runtime

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for function execution. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 3. The execution of the function is terminated once the timeout period expires
parameters.help_zh: 函数运行的超时时间，单位为秒，最小1秒，默认3秒。函数超过这个时间后会被终止执行
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The listening port of the HTTP server in a custom runtime or a Custom Container runtime
parameters.help_zh: 自定义、自定义容器运行时HTTP Server的监听端口
parameters.name: ca_port

parameters.help_en: The environment variables configured for the function. You can obtain the values of the environment variables from the function. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69777.html
parameters.help_zh: 函数的环境变量，您可以在函数中通过环境变量访问环境变量。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69777.html
parameters.name: environment_variables

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of requests that a function instance can process at a time
parameters.help_zh: 实例最大并发度
parameters.name: instance_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The soft concurrency of the instance. You can use this property to implement graceful scale-out of instances. When the number of concurrent requests exceeds the instance's soft concurrency limit, scale-out is triggered. If your instance has a long startup time, you can specify a soft concurrency value to initiate the instance in advance.

The value must be less than or equal to that of instanceConcurrency
parameters.help_zh:
实例软并发度，用于优雅扩容。当实例上的并发数超过软并发度时，会触发实例扩容。例如，您的实例启动较慢，可以通过设置合适的软实例并发度，提前启动实例。

取值小于或等于instanceConcurrency
parameters.name: instance_soft_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the function. Valid values:

e1: elastic instance
c1: performance instance
fc.gpu.tesla.1: GPU-accelerated instance utilizing Tesla series GPUs
fc.gpu.ampere.1: GPU-accelerated instances utilizing Ampere series GPUs
fc.gpu.ada.1: GPU-accelerated instances utilizing Ada series GPUs
g1: same as fc.gpu.tesla.1

Default value: e1
parameters.help_zh:
函数的实例类型，取值如下：
e1：弹性实例。
c1：性能实例。
fc.gpu.tesla.1：GPU Tesla 系列实例类型。
fc.gpu.ampere.1：GPU Ampere 系列实例类型。
fc.gpu.ada.1：GPU Ada 系列实例类型。
g1：同 fc.gpu.tesla.1。

默认值：e1
parameters.name: instance_type

fields.help_en: The custom commands that are used to start containers in the custom runtime. If multiple commands are specified, the commands are concatenated in order
fields.help_zh: Custom Runtime启动的自定义入口命令列表。列表内有多个命令时按顺序拼接
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The arguments that are used to start containers in the custom runtime. Pass the arguments in order
fields.help_zh: Custom Runtime启动命令接收的参数列表，按顺序依次传入
fields.name: args

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the custom runtime function
parameters.help_zh: Custom Runtime函数详细配置
parameters.name: custom_runtime_config

fields.help_en: The handler of the function. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
fields.help_zh: 函数执行的入口，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
fields.name: handler

fields.help_en: The timeout period for function execution. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 运行的超时时间，单位为秒
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en: The lifecycle hook configurations
fields.help_zh: 生命周期函数配置
fields.name: pre_freeze

fields.help_zh: 函数执行的入口，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157704.html
fields.name: handler

fields.help_en: The timeout period for function execution. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 运行的超时时间，单位为秒
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en: The lifecycle hook configurations
fields.help_zh: 生命周期函数配置
fields.name: pre_stop

parameters.help_en: The lifecycle configurations of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例生命周期配置
parameters.name: instance_lifecycle_config

fields.help_en: The IP addresses of DNS servers
fields.help_zh: DNS服务器的IP地址列表
fields.name: name_servers

fields.help_en: The search domains of the DNS server
fields.help_zh: DNS搜索域列表
fields.name: searches

fields.help_en: The parameter
fields.help_zh: 配置项名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value
fields.help_zh: 配置项值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The configuration items in the resolv.conf file. Each item is a key-value pair in the key:value format, in which the key is required
fields.help_zh: resolv.conf文件中的配置项列表。每一项对应一个键值对，格式为key:value，其中键为必填
fields.name: dns_options

parameters.help_en: The custom Domain Name System (DNS) settings of the function
parameters.help_zh: 函数自定义DNS配置
parameters.name: custom_dns

fields.help_en: The custom health check URL of the container. The URL length cannot exceed 2,048 characters
fields.help_zh: 容器自定义健康检查URL地址。长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: http_get_url

fields.help_en: The duration after the container is started before health checks are initiated. Valid values: 0 to 120. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 容器启动到发起健康检查的延迟。取值范围0~120，单位为秒，默认值为0
fields.name: initial_delay_seconds

fields.help_en: The interval between two consecutive health checks. Valid values: 1 to 120. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: 健康检查周期。取值范围1~120，单位为秒，默认值为3
fields.name: period_seconds

fields.help_en: The timeout period of a health check. Valid values: 1 to 3. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 健康检查超时时间。取值范围1~3，单位为秒，默认值为1
fields.name: timeout_seconds

fields.help_en: The threshold for health check failures. When this value is reached, the system considers the check failed. Valid values: 1 to 120. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: 健康检查失败次数阈值，达到该值后系统认为检查失败。取值范围1~120，单位为秒，默认值为3
fields.name: failure_threshold

fields.help_en: The threshold for health check successes. When this value is reached, the system considers the check succeeded. Valid values: 1 to 120. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 健康检查成功次数阈值，达到该值后系统认为检查成功。取值范围1~120，单位为秒，默认值为1
fields.name: success_threshold

parameters.help_en: The custom health check configurations of the function. This parameter is applicable only to custom runtimes and Custom Container runtimes
parameters.help_zh: 函数自定义健康检查配置，仅适用于Custom Runtime和Custom Container
parameters.name: custom_health_check_config

parameters.help_en: The CPU size of the function. Unit: vCPUs. The value is a multiple of 0.05
parameters.help_zh: 函数的CPU规格，单位为vCPU，为0.05 vCPU的倍数
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The disk size of the function. Unit: MB. Valid values: 512 and 10240
parameters.help_zh: 函数的磁盘规格，单位为MB，可选值为512 MB或10240 MB
parameters.name: disk_size

parameters.help_en: The GPU memory size of the function. Unit: MB. The value is a multiple of 1024
parameters.help_zh: function的GPU显存规格，单位为MB，为1024MB的倍数
parameters.name: gpu_memory_size

parameters.help_en: The CRC-64 value of the function code package
parameters.help_zh: 函数代码包的CRC-64值
parameters.name: x_fc_code_checksum

parameters.help_en: The time on which the function is invoked. The format of the value is: EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the request. The value is the same as that of the requestId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh: 调用函数的ID，与返回参数requestId对应
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id
